messages.text: Hunt follows European heroics with 200m silver in Diamond League

metadata.summary: Amy Hunt followed up her historic European Championships performance by finishing second in the 200 metres at the Lausanne Diamond League.
metadata.content: Amy Hunt follows European Championships heroics with 200m silver in Diamond League | Athletics News | Sky Sports Home Sports Football F1 Cricket Rugby Union Rugby League Golf Boxing NFL Tennis NBA Racing Darts Netball MMA More Sports Scores Football F1 Cricket Rugby Union Rugby League Golf NFL Tennis Watch Sky Bet More Podcasts Live on Sky Get Sky Sports Sky Sports App Sky Sports with no contract Kick It Out British South Asians in Football Watch Sky Sports Commonwealth Games Athletics News Amy Hunt follows European Championships heroics with 200m silver in Diamond League Britain’s Amy Hunt finished second in 22.32sec, a week after her remarkable performance in Birmingham, where she became the first athlete to win four gold medals at a single European Championship; Hunt edged Nigeria’s Favour Ofili into third in a photo finish Last Updated: 21/08/26 10:52pm Britain's Amy Hunt travelled to Switzerland on the back of winning four gold medals at the European Championships Amy Hunt followed up her historic European Championships performance by finishing second in the 200 metres at the Lausanne Diamond League. Less than a week after completing her set of four gold medals in Birmingham, the sprinter was on the starting blocks in Switzerland and she edged out Nigerian Favour Ofili in a photo finish. Hunt's time of 22.32sec was some way off American winner Kayla White's 22.18, while two-time world champion Shericka Jackson failed to finish after suffering a leg injury. Zharnel Hughes
